notes: Parts 16-20: 50 groups, 54 rows. Merged groups (one row each): Corma = 'corma' + 'cyber startup' + 'exclusive' (part 18) + 'defensive' (part 19); Stark Future = 'stark future' + 'europes first electric motorcycle'; Ramon.Space = 'ramon space' + 'space tech firm'; Noeri = 'noeri' + 'nvidia backs noeris 110'; Delix Therapeutics = 'uc davis spinout delix' + 'delix therapeutics'. The three Acima settlement groups and the two Ondas earnings groups are the same non-funding stories and are kept as one not-funding row per group. Round-ups expanded: 'crypto dealbook november funding' yields 10 rows (Seva Money, Lithium, River One [M&A], Index Industries, Alta, Marble, Griffin, Kailash, Spout Finance, DI); HQ is 'unknown' for all but Griffin because the round-up gives none. 'african startups' is an October monthly report kept as a single not-funding row; its two named $40M October deals (ABA Life, Morocco, from Admaius Capital Partners; East Africa Foods, Tanzania) were not expanded because the article gives no announcement dates and they predate the window. Split rounds: Marrow Therapeutics into Series A ($53M) and Series B ($120M); Clara into Series C equity ($65M) and a $40M debt facility renewal. Combined totals kept as one row because no split is given: Mavria ($130M across pre-seed and seed), General Flash ($128M across Seed and Series A). Vaeridion is recorded as the EUR 30M venture round; the EUR 120M+ headline also counts a EUR 94.5M EU Innovation Fund grant made available earlier. Blue J: about US$100M of the US$176M is secondary. 16 web lookups used: vVardis (found to be an NYSE IPO, so public-company), Galvanize (pulse2 article plus WSGR notice for lead, investors and HQ), Corma (HQ: Tel Aviv and San Francisco, so US under the dual-HQ rule), Ramon.Space (4 lookups: jpost article gave investors and AI claims; HQ city not confirmed, trackers list California addresses, so US/CA at confidence 0.7), Zeromatter (3 lookups), Index Industries, Alta, Griffin and Databento (is_ai_ml checks). Zeromatter is low confidence: the only in-feed source is a blocked Dealroom headline saying $110M; secondary coverage says the company reported $160M raised in total at a $1.1B valuation across seed, Series A (Bedrock Capital) and Series B (Spark Capital), and one outlet cites $40M. Round type and investors for the $110M were not resolved, so investors are left empty. Galvanize and Ramon.Space investor lists and the Galvanize lead come from fetched pages, not the part text, so their evidence spans (other than amount) will not match the candidate corpus. Imprint is_ai_ml=true is a judgement call under the broad rule (release cites AI capabilities and an MCP server for AI agents). Databento is false (AI labs are customers, product is market data APIs). EUR amounts converted at 1.125, the rate implied by the Vaeridion article (EUR 120M = USD 135M).
